# @vesk/runtime — llms.txt (machine-focused reference)

Package: `@vesk/runtime` v0.1.6 · ESM + TypeScript · source `/root/vesk/packages/runtime/src`
Companion docs: `docs.md` (human), `AGENTS.md` (agent rules).
Every signature below was verified against source. Unverifiable items are
marked `[UNVERIFIED]`.

## Package / entry points (package.json)

```json
"exports": {
  ".":        { "types": "./dist/index-client.d.ts",  "default": "./dist/index-client.js"  },
  "./client": { "types": "./dist/index-client.d.ts",  "default": "./dist/index-client.js"  },
  "./server": { "types": "./dist/index-server.d.ts",  "default": "./dist/index-server.js"  },
  "./src/*":  "./dist/*.js",
  "./package.json": "./package.json"
}
```
- `type: module`, `engines.node >= 20`, dependency `@vesk/compiler ^0.1.0`.
- Main/types point at the **client** entry.
- Server-only APIs are NOT reachable from the `.`/`client` entries.

---

## 2. Full export inventory — index-server.ts

Same core exports as the client entry (runtime subset + blocks + context +
resource + portal + router + seo + image + experiment + form + md + action),
with these **differences**:

- **Server does NOT export**: any `hydrate*`, `needsHydration`,
  `hydrationCount`, `createHydrateWalker`, `collectVskMarkers`, `reactiveProps`,
  `bindValue`/`bindChecked`/`bindGroup`, `reconcile`, and the client-only
  ripple-runtime extras (`schedule_update`, `queue_microtask`,
  `is_mutating_allowed`, `tracking`, `teardown`, `run_block`, `run_teardown`,
  `set_tracking`, `set_active_reaction`, `is_block_dirty`,
  `destroy_non_branch_children`, `disable_scoped_flush`).
- **`useParams` from router is aliased**: `useParams as routerParams` to avoid
  clashing with `request.ts`'s `useParams`.
- **Adds the request module**:
```ts
cookies(): CookieStore           // Proxy over a cookie jar; .get(name), .getAll(), .toString()
headers(): Record<string, string | Function | undefined>   // Proxy; .get(name), .has(name), .entries()
locals(): Record<string, unknown>
class ServerRequest extends Request { get/set cookies: CookieStore; get/set params: Record<string,string>; get/set locals: Record<string,unknown> }
class ServerResponse extends Response { static json(body, init?); static redirect(url, status=307); static rewrite(url); static next() }
class VeskRequest extends ServerRequest { parsedUrl: URL; query: Record<string,string>; ip: string; protocol: string; body: Promise<unknown> }
VeskResponse  // Proxy over an internal _VeskResponse Response subclass
withValidation(request: Request, schema: { safeParse: (data) => { success: boolean; error?: { issues: {path:(string|number)[];message:string}[] }; data?: unknown } }, opts?: { jsonOnly?: boolean }): Promise<unknown | Response>
useBody(): Promise<unknown>
useParams(): Record<string, string>       // request params (NOT router)
useRequest(): RequestContext | null
cors(options?: CorsOptions): CorsMiddleware
defineHook(name: string, fn: Function): void
removeHook(name: string, fn: Function): void
runHooks(name: string, ...args: unknown[]): Promise<Response | undefined>
webhook(options: WebhookOptions): (request: Request) => Promise<Response>
signCookie(name, value, host?): Promise<string>
unsignCookie(name, signedValue, host?): Promise<string | null>
setSignedCookie(name, value, options?, host?): Promise<string>
readSignedCookie(name, cookieString, host?): Promise<string | null>
applyRequestSecurity(request: VeskRequest, response: VeskResponseInstance): void
```
- **Adds the ISR module**:
```ts
isr(key: string, fetcher: () => Promise<unknown>, opts?: { tags?: string[]; revalidate?: number }): Promise<{ data: unknown; stale: boolean }>
revalidatePath(path: string): Promise<void>
revalidateTag(tag: string): Promise<void>
clearIsrCache(): void
revalidateComponent(key: string): void
pageIsr(path: string, renderFn: () => Promise<{ html: string; headers?: Record<string,string> }>, opts?): Promise<{ html: string; headers: Record<string,string>; stale: boolean }>
componentIsr(key: string, renderFn: () => string | Promise<string>, opts?): Promise<string>
isrConfigToRevalidate(config: unknown): number   // number or { revalidate } -> TTL, else 0
```
- `VeskResponseInstance` (interface, in request.ts) exposes:
`setStatus(code)`, `build()`, `text()`, `json()`, `setCookie(name, value, opts?)`,
`clearCookie(name, opts?)`, `setCsp(policy)`, `setSecurityHeader(name, value)`,
`cache(ttlSeconds)`, `noCache()`, `cors(opts?)`, `_flushSecurityHeaders()`, `readonly status`.

## 3. Key internal modules (not re-exported through the index)

### `ripple-constants.ts`
```ts

FOR_BLOCK=1<<5, TRY_BLOCK=1<<6, IF_BLOCK=1<<7, SWITCH_BLOCK=1<<8,
COMPOSITE_BLOCK=1<<9, ASYNC_BLOCK=1<<10, HEAD_BLOCK=1<<11, PRE_EFFECT_BLOCK=1<<12,

```

### `ripple-utils.ts`

### `router-match.ts`
```ts
interface RouteNode { path: string; fullPath?: string; isGroup?: boolean; isDynamic?: boolean; isCatchAll?: boolean; page?: Function | null; layout?: Function | null; loading?: Function | null; error?: Function | null; notFound?: Function | null; children?: RouteNode[]; segmentCount?: number; _matchChain?: RouteNode[]; loader?: Function; props?: Record<string, unknown>; _head?: string; [k: string]: unknown }
interface RouteMatch { matchChain: RouteNode[]; params: Record<string, string>; pathname?: string }
compileRoutePattern(fullPath: string): { regex: RegExp; paramNames: string[] }
collectLayouts(nodes, pathParts): { layout: Function; node: RouteNode }[]
matchRouteNode(node, pathParts): boolean
extractParams(node, pathParts): Record<string, string>
flattenLayoutChain(tree, pathParts, result?): RouteNode[]
matchRoute(tree, pathname): RouteMatch | null
buildTreeFromMap(routes: Record<string, Function>, _options?): RouteNode[]
```
Note: `compileRoutePattern` builds a `RegExp` via string construction — this
is the router, NOT the compiler; the no-regex rule applies to
`packages/compiler/src` only.

### `router-components.ts` (extra exports)
`RouterCtx = createContext<Router | null>(null)`, `__isHydrating`,
`setIsHydrating(v)`, `_state` (tracked path/params/search), `_scrollPositions`
(Map), `_isPopStateNavigation`, `setIsPopStateNavigation(v)`, `setCurrentRouter(r)`,
`getCurrentRouter()`, `findLoadingComponent(chain)`, `findErrorComponent(chain)`,
`findNotFoundComponent(chain)`, `showLoadingInContainer(container, loadingFn, params)`,
`handleScroll(pathname, isReplace?)`, `applyHead(headHtml)`, `_state`, `_outletId`.

### `suspense.ts`
No exports. Placeholder only (comments describe compiler-level Suspense as
future work). Gate: use `if (loading)` + `createResource`.

### `hmr-client.ts`
IIFE (no module exports) — injected as a script by tooling; connects to
`/{proto}://host/_vesk/hmr`, handles `update`/`reload`/`error`/`css-update`/
`compiling` messages, calls `router.hmrUpdate()`, renders a dev dot + error
overlay. Not part of the public API.


### `track.ts` — LEGACY module (do not import)
A deprecated, **unused** reactivity module with its OWN distinct API. It is
NOT re-exported by `index-client.ts`/`index-server.ts` and is not imported by
any runtime/compiler/cli source (verified by grep). It only survives in
`dist/` because it is compiled alongside the active modules. **This is NOT the
runtime's reactivity system** — the active one is `ripple-runtime.ts` +
`ripple-blocks.ts`. Do not use these APIs:
```ts
class Cell<T> { get(): T; peek(): T; set(newValue: T): boolean; update(fn: (current: T) => T): boolean; unsubscribe(effect: Effect): void }
class Effect { run(): void; destroy(): void }
track<T>(initialValue: T): Cell<T>
effect(fn: () => void): Effect
derived<T>(fn: () => T): Cell<T>
batch<T>(fn: () => T): T        // legacy batching — the active runtime has NO batch
```
This is the only place a `batch` symbol exists in `@vesk/runtime/src`; the
active barrels/modules export no `batch`. Treat it as dead code pending
removal; never import/emit `batch` (matches repo AGENTS.md rule).



---

## 4. Data flow

### 4.1 SSR resource handoff (`resource.ts`)
1. SSR flag: `isServer() === !!globalThis.__vsk_ssr`.
2. Server render calls `createResource(fn, key)` → `startRequest(handle)`.
3. `startRequest` (server branch): dedupe by key via `__vsk_fetch_inflight`;
   run `runFetcher` (handles `retry`/`retryDelay` exponential backoff and
   `timeout` via `Promise.race`); then `setSsrData(key, data)` →
   `globalThis.__vsk_ssr_data[key]`; also `trackSsrPromise(prom)` pushes into
   `__vsk_ssr_promises` (or `__vsk_ssr_promises_${__vsk_ssr_token}`).
4. After render: server calls `resolveSsrResources()` →
   `Promise.allSettled(__vsk_ssr_promises)`, returns `__vsk_ssr_data`, deletes
   `__vsk_ssr_promises`. The object is serialized into the page.
5. Client bootstrap injects that object as `globalThis.__vsk_ssr_data`.
6. Client `createResource` → `getSsrData(resourceKey)`; if defined,
   `settle(handle, ssrData)` immediately and `writeCache` — **no refetch**.
7. Otherwise client `startRequest`: honors `staleTime` client cache
   (`__vsk_fetch_cache`), dedupes via `__vsk_fetch_inflight`, and on resolve
   writes cache + `settle`. `refresh()`/`revalidate` aborts inflight and
   re-fetches all registry handles for the key.

### 4.2 Hydration claiming (`hydrate.ts`)
- SSR emits `<!--vsk-->` comments at reactive boundaries.
- `hydrate(container, fn, props)` builds a `createHydrateWalker`, then calls
  `componentFn(props, new Map(), walker)`.
- `walker.nextElement(tag?)` advances marker index; for each marker it reads
  `marker.nextElementSibling` (the claimed element), `marker.remove()`, strips
  trailing/leading text nodes, and returns the existing element (or creates a
  fresh one when absent / tag mismatch).
- `hydrateViewport` splits markers into in-viewport vs deferred; deferred are
  relabeled `<!--vsk-hold-->` and hydrated lazily by `IntersectionObserver`
  (converting the hold back to `vsk`).
- `hydrateIdle` chunks markers (`chunkSize=10`, `timeout=3000`) via
  `requestIdleCallback`.
- `hydrateOnInteraction` waits for the first of `['click','touchstart',
  'focus','mouseenter']` (configurable via `options.events`), returning
  `{ cancel, hydrateNow }`.

### 4.3 Router navigation (`router.ts` / `router-components.ts`)
- `createRouter(...).start()` sets currentRouter, disables native
  scroll-restoration, and renders the initial match.
- `Link` click (no modifier keys, not `_blank`) → `preventDefault` →
  `useNavigate()(href)` → `router.navigate(path)` → `window.history.pushState`,
  `set` path/params/search tracked state, fetch route data (with `_dataPromises`
  dedupe), `ensureChunk` for code-split pages, render match chain into
  `Outlet` placeholders, `handleScroll`.
- `applyHead(headHtml)` replaces `<head>` content from route data.
- `NavLink` computes active state from `usePathname()` and adds `activeClass`
  (default `'active'`) + `aria-current="page"`.
- Guards: throwing `Redirect`/`NotFoundError` during load short-circuits to a
  redirect / 404 response (server) or navigation (client).

### 4.4 Form / action submit (`form.ts` + `action.ts`)
- SSR: `Form` renders `<form action=… method=… novalidate>` with `<Field>`
  error slots (`data-vsk-field` / `data-vsk-error`). Server field errors read
  from `globalThis.__vesk_action_errors`.
- Client hydration: `bindFormSubmit` attaches a submit handler → reads fields,
  client-validates `rules` per Field; on success `fetch(resolvedAction,
  {method, body:data})`.
- Action post is routed to `/_vesk/action/<id>`; server runs
  `validateActionInput`; on `{ ok:false, issues }` it maps issues back to
  fields, toggles error `<div>`s, dispatches `vsk-error`; on non-OK response
  throws; on success dispatches `vsk-success` and calls `onSuccess`.
- Always toggles `vsk-submitting`/`vsk-loading` and re-enables the submit
  button.

---

## 5. Conventions & idioms

- **snake_case internals, camelCase public**: internals are `flush_sync`,
  `peek_tracked`, `schedule_update`, `on_destroy`, `create_component_ctx`,
  `with_block`, `queue_microtask`; the public exports alias them to
  `flushSync`, `peek`, `on_destroy` (kept snake), etc.
- **`set`-prefix for writers**: `set`, `set_active_block`,
  `set_active_component`, `set_active_reaction`, `set_tracking`,
  `setSsrData`, `setCookie` (response), `setCsp`, `setSecurityHeader`.
- **`flush`/`create`/`resume`/`pause`/`destroy` verbs**: `flush_sync`,
  `flush_updates`, `createResource`, `createRouter`, `createContext`,
  `createHydrateWalker`, `pause_block`, `resume_block`, `destroy_block`,
  `destroy_block_children`.
- **No `batch` in the active runtime**: never import/emit `batch`. The barrels
  and `ripple-runtime`/`ripple-blocks` have no `batch`. Use `flushSync`. The
  only `batch` symbol in `src/` is inside the deprecated, unused `track.ts`
  (see section) — treat it as dead code.
- **Scoped flushing**: `schedule_update` sets `UPDATE_SOURCE` on the target
  and `CONTAINS_UPDATE` up the tree; `flush_updates` runs only on-path blocks
  under the `scope_root`. If a foreign dependency is registered,
  `disable_scoped_flush` global flips to `true` → full-root flush.
- **Effects run in three passes** in `flush_updates`: `pre_effect` blocks →
  other render/update blocks → `effect` blocks.
- **Circular static imports are normal** between `ripple-runtime` and
  `ripple-blocks` (ESM handles it); keep function use deferred/inside
  closures where needed.
- **Component functions are triple-arg**: `(props, registry, hydrateWalker)`
  across Form/Field/Md/Link/NavLink/Portal — SSR returns strings, hydration
  claims via walker, SPA returns DOM nodes.
- **SSR detection**: `typeof document === 'undefined'` (component helpers) or
  `!!globalThis.__vsk_ssr` (resource module). Don't mix.
- **Global namespaces** used (read/write `globalThis`): `__vsk_ssr`,
  `__vsk_ssr_data`, `__vsk_ssr_promises[_token]`, `__vsk_ssr_token`,
  `__vsk_ssr_base_url`, `__vsk_fetch_cache`, `__vsk_fetch_inflight`,
  `__vsk_fetch_registry`, `__vesk_request`, `__vesk_hooks`,
  `__vesk_actions`, `__vesk_action_errors`, `__vesk_ctx`, `__vesk_router`,
  `__updatedComponents`, `__vsk_experiments`, `__vesk_hmr_eval`.


---

## 6. Edge cases & gotchas

- `set()` no-ops when the new value `===` the old value (by `!==` check).
- `set()` throws inside derived evaluation (`is_mutating_allowed === false`).
- `get_tracked`/`get_derived` **throw** `ASYNC_DERIVED_READ_THROWN` when the
  value is `SUSPENSE_PENDING`/`SUSPENSE_REJECTED`; `peek` does NOT throw and
  returns the raw `__v`.
- `flush_microtasks` throws *"Maximum update depth exceeded…"* after 1001
  flush cycles (effect read/write same state loop).
- `flush_sync` recursion: while in sync mode it flushes queued root blocks
  recursively until quiescent; `flush_count` is reset to 0 on exit.
- `tick()` uses `requestAnimationFrame`; in non-browser environments this
  needs a polyfill / jsdom.
- `user_effect` returns `void` (deferred) if the component isn't mounted yet;
  `effect` always returns a `Block`.
- `Tracked.__v` read via `peek_tracked` may be a raw value or the
  `UNINITIALIZED` symbol for deriveds before first read.
- `queue_microtask` batches ALL queued callbacks into a single
  `queueMicrotask`; `queue_microtask()` with no fn still queues an empty
  flush (used to schedule the scheduler).
- Hydration walker strips text nodes only on claimed elements; a missing / SSR
  mismatch falls back to `document.createElement(tag || 'div')`.
- `reactiveProps` only unwraps ripple objects (`typeof val.f === 'number'`).
- ISR caches are **in-memory** and shared per-process; `revalidate<=0`
  bypasses caching entirely; revalidation failures keep the stale entry.
- Signed-cookie helpers lazily `await import('@vesk/compiler/src/server-utils')`
  and throw if `@vesk/compiler` is unavailable.
- `VeskResponse` is a Proxy over an internal class — `new VeskResponse(...)`
  works like a `Response`; fluent builders return the instance.
- CORS `cors()` returns a middleware that can preflight (returns Response) or
  apply headers to an existing response (`applyCors`).
- `Experiment` on SSR seeds by name; on client includes a `sessionStorage`
  user id and (sticky) a cookie; writes to `window.__vsk_experiments` when
  `track` is true.
- `Image` generates `srcset` from `${base}-${w}w${ext}` (i.e. it assumes
  pre-generated responsive files named `name-640w.jpg` etc.).
- `Md`/`JsonLd` escape everything — no raw HTML pass-through; `</script>` is
  escaped in JSON-LD.
- Server `useParams` (request) vs client `useParams` (router): different
  semantics; on server the router variant is `routerParams`.

---

## 7. Cross-module dependencies

- `@vesk/runtime` depends on **`@vesk/compiler ^0.1.0`** (package.json).
  Runtime only dynamically imports compiler internals for signed cookies
  (`@vesk/compiler/src/server-utils`, then `@vesk/compiler` fallback) —
  optional at runtime.
- Internal runtime module graph (all resolved through `@vesk/runtime/src/*`):
  - `ripple-runtime` ⇄ `ripple-blocks` (mutual import); both →
    `ripple-constants` + `ripple-utils`.
  - `hydrate` → `ripple-runtime` (`get`).
  - `resource` → `ripple-runtime` (tracked/get/set/scope/on_destroy) +
    `ripple-blocks` (is_destroyed).
  - `router` → `ripple-runtime` (track/get/set/scope/set_active_block) +
    `ripple-blocks` (root) + `hydrate` (walkers) + `router-match` +
    `router-components`.
  - `router-components` → `context` (createContext) + `ripple-runtime`
    (get/_state).
  - `bindings` → `ripple-blocks` (effect/render) + `ripple-runtime`
    (get/set) + `ripple-utils`.
  - `reconcile` → `ripple-blocks` (destroy_block).
  - `form`, `md`, `router` use the `HydrateWalker` type from `hydrate`.
  - `action` → `form` (ValidationRule type).
- `@vesk/runtime` re-exports are consumed by `packages/compiler` codegen and
  `packages/cli` build tooling; keep the barrel files (`index-*.ts`) in sync
  with any new module export.

---

## 8. Test inventory

Self-contained scripts (custom `describe`/`it`/`expect`), run with
`npx tsx packages/runtime/src/<file>.test.ts` from the runtime package (or
repo) root. Case counts via `grep -cE '^\s*(it|test)\('`:

| File | Count | Covers |
|------|------:|--------|
| `track.test.ts` | 14 | track/get/set, effect re-runs, derived chains, DOM-like updates |
| `hydrate.test.ts` | 13 | walker, full/viewport/idle, reactiveProps |
| `router.test.ts` | 32 | matching, params, nav, guards |
| `resource.test.ts` | 27 | SSR handoff, cache, retry, dedupe |
| `request.test.ts` | 90 | ServerRequest/Response, cookies, validation, cors, signed cookies |
| `form.test.ts` | 34 | Form/Field, rules, submit flow, action integration |
| `isr.test.ts` | 14 | isr/pageIsr/componentIsr, revalidate |
| `seo.test.ts` | 14 | JsonLd + schemas |
| `image.test.ts` | 12 | Image SSR/attrs/srcset |
| `md.test.ts` | 35 | tokenizer/parser, blocks, escaping |
| `experiment.test.ts` | 10 | variant selection, sticky, tracking |
| **Total** | **~295** | 11 test files |

No standalone `action.test.ts` — action APIs are exercised via `form.test.ts`
[verified by filename inventory]. No `bindings`/`reconcile`/`portal` test
files present.


---

## 9. If modifying X, update Y (checklist)

- **Add a new export in any module** → update both `index-client.ts` and
  `index-server.ts` barrels (decide client-only vs server-only vs shared), and
  add it to the matching section of `docs.md` + `llms.txt` export inventory.
- **Change a reactivity primitive** (`track`/`get`/`set`/`derived`/
  `flush_sync`/`schedule_update`) → update `track.test.ts` AND run the root
  production-hydration check `node hydration-test.mjs` (reactivity changes
  must be validated on the hydration path, per repo AGENTS.md).
- **Change scheduler/flush behavior** (`flush_updates`, `flush_sync`,
  `queue_microtask`, `is_block_dirty`) → re-run `track.test.ts` and
  `hydrate.test.ts`; verify both expression-mode and statement-mode component
  bodies still work.
- **Change hydration** (`hydrate.ts`) → update `hydrate.test.ts`, add a
  production-hydration test in the root `hydration-test.mjs`, and keep the
  `<!--vsk-->` / `<!--vsk-hold-->` marker contract in sync with
  `packages/compiler` (compiler emits the markers).
- **Change resources** (`resource.ts`) → update `resource.test.ts`; keep the
  SSR handoff globals (`__vsk_ssr_data`/`__vsk_ssr_promises`) and
  `resolveSsrResources` contract in sync with the server renderer that calls
  it.
- **Change router** (`router.ts`/`router-components.ts`/`router-match.ts`) →
  update `router.test.ts`; keep `index-server.ts`'s `useParams as routerParams`
  alias and the `RouteNode`/`RouteMatch` shapes in sync with
  `packages/compiler` route-tree generation and `packages/cli` file-router
  build.
- **Change request/server classes** (`request.ts`) → update `request.test.ts`;
  keep `VeskRequest`/`VeskResponse` + security flows in sync with the server
  integration code that constructs them.
- **Change ISR** (`isr.ts`) → update `isr.test.ts`; keep the in-memory
  cache/tag semantics documented (process-local).
- **Change shared component helpers** (`Form`/`Field`/`Md`/`Link`/`NavLink`/
  `Portal`/`Image`) → keep the triple-arg `(props, registry, hydrateWalker)`
  signature; update the corresponding test file.
- **Change `@vesk/runtime/src/*` internal import paths** → regenerate
  `dist/` (`npm run build` or repo `build-packages.ts`) because the exports
  map (`./src/*` → `dist/*.js`) resolves them.
- **Change tests directory / add a test file** → update the test inventory
  table in this file and the "How to run the tests" section of `docs.md`.
- **Never add `batch` to the active runtime** — if a new batching API is
  proposed, name it per convention (e.g. `flushSync`) and update the "no
  batch" rules in `docs.md`, `llms.txt`, and `AGENTS.md`. Remove/deprecate the
  legacy `track.ts` module (`Cell`/`Effect`/`batch`) rather than wiring it in:
  it is unused, and adding it to a barrel would introduce a second, conflicting
  reactivity API.
